newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia nabs Israeli wanted on 188 counts in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Colombia nabs Israeli wanted on 188 counts in U.S..

text.p: An Israeli citizen wanted on scores of drug-related charges in the United States was arrested on Tuesday in Colombia's southwest city of Cali, authorities said.

A statement from the state security police or DAS identified the fugitive from U.S. justice as Eli Tisona and said he would be handed over by Interpol to American judicial officials "within the next few days."
He operated in Colombia under three different aliases and an arrest order for him was issued in the United States on Sept. 10, the statement said.
It added that Tisona was wanted on a total of 188 counts of money laundering, tax evasion, fraud and illicit interstate and international commerce.
Israeli embassy officials could not be reached for immediate comment on possible moves to block Tisona's extradition to the United States or to say whether he was also wanted in Israel.
